race.description: Bendigo Bank St Arnaud Mdn Plate
race.comment: FOX PHIRE (9) is back after a break of six months. At the last run before the layoff she finished eighth over 1200m at Donald. Looks up to the mark following a trial win at Camperdown. FULLY FUNDED (4) is becoming a little costly this prep, but hasn't run poorly. Peak fitness now and probably suited back to this trip from 1300m last week. SCUSIES (6) resumes after closing last campaign with an eighth over 1000m at Ballarat Synthetic, beaten 7 lengths but will be fitter for a recent trial win.
